falsifier: fewer than a tenth of the faceted citations in E11's two archived passes name a strict subset of their kind's facets
hypothesis: a material share of the critic's question-kind citations wait on a strict subset of the kind's facets, so a facet-level coverage count (#1306) would count those findings as covered sooner
intervention: read every citation of a faceted kind in E11's archived rulings (both passes, 13 tuned cases): 249 of 261 typed citations name a kind with facets. Classed which facets each verdict reason names, by a word table, then corrected by reading. Word table: 139 name a strict subset, 101 exactly one facet. By reading: about 80 wait on one facet (reachability 42 of 42, all named-callers: a foothold that reaches or observes an internal interface; authorization-scope about 12 of 57; audit-evidence 9 of 37; stored-copy-access 4 of 52, the integrity scenarios; content-validation 4 of 4; data-exposure 3 of 3). The 15 single-facet capacity-limits hits are a word-table error: those reasons list generic capacity controls, and every capacity-limits citation waits on the kind. A whole-kind count needs 657 facet answers over the 249 citations; the word table puts a facet count at 443. The count rules on nothing: questions.py states that covered_so_far is coverage, not a verdict, and an answer reaches the lanes once one facet says more than unknown (ADR 0050). So the ceiling on findings and on must-finds is zero; the gain is the report page's count, and it shows only where a submitter leaves the other facets of a kind unknown, which no real submission has measured (#1286)
reconsider_when: a real submission shows how often a submitter answers some facets of a kind and leaves the others unknown (#1286); or the coverage count gates a step rather than informs a page
scope: STRIDE, 13 tuned cases, E11's two terra passes at prompt 59a4a89; one agent's reading, not signed; a citation per (claim, element, kind) in each pass, so a repeated citation counts twice; it prices the coverage count only, not the critic's fallback rate under a larger enum, which needs the replay #1306 names
signature: a finding waits on one facet and the coverage count asks every facet of its kind
